brief:
Hebrew Channel 12 reported that a government coalition including Gadi Eisenkot and ultra-Orthodox parties is moving toward formation, contrary to earlier expectations. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is waging a campaign to obstruct the move, the outlet said.

Ultra-Orthodox parties told Netanyahu they have nothing left to lose, according to Channel 12's report. The coalition efforts suggest a shift in Israeli political alignments as talks progress.
dek: Hebrew Channel 12 reported that a government coalition including Gadi Eisenkot and ultra-Orthodox parties is moving toward formation, contrary to earlier expectations.
title: Israeli coalition with Eisenkot, ultra-Orthodox parties moves toward formation
